map.原值 500 万、成新率系数 0.8 → 现值=500×0.8=400 万；本工: Original value of 5 million yuan at a condition rate of 0.8 gives present value = 500 × 0.8 = 4 million; in cost mode this tool outputs total = A × B.
map.同样 500 万，成新率 0.9（较新）现值 450 万，比 0.8 多 50: On the same 5 million yuan, a condition rate of 0.9 (newer) gives a present value of 4.5 million, 500,000 more than at 0.8, corresponding to roughly 5 years of useful life difference.
map.年限法成新率公式？: What is the age-life condition rate formula?
map.成新率=(耐用年限−已使用年限)/耐用年限×100%，结果低于 0 时取 0；保: Condition rate = (useful life − elapsed years)/useful life × 100%, floored at 0; good maintenance can be added on top through the scoring method.
map.耐用年限一般多少？: What is a typical useful life?
map.钢混住宅常 50–70 年、砖混 40–50 年，具体按当地定额或评估指引。: Reinforced concrete housing is usually 50-70 years and brick-concrete 40-50 years; follow the local quota or appraisal guidance.
